name: docket
description: Takes notes in your Zoom, Teams and Google Meet calls: transcribes on your computer, summarizes, and turns every meeting's action items into one to-do list.
author: Bilal

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Docket listens to your microphone while it takes meeting notes.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Docket records the meeting's audio so it can transcribe the other people on the call.
